node.statement: Finite-dimensional l1 support fact: for any nonempty compact convex C and any point x0 with H0=dist_1(x0,C), there exists an affine functional phi whose linear part has l_infty norm at most 1, with phi(x0)=H0 and phi(y)<=0 for every y in C; consequently phi(x)<=dist_1(x,C) for every x.
